meta.title: This island literally changes its country every six months #shorts
meta.description:
Imagine owning a piece of land, but every six months, you suddenly have to obey a completely different country's laws. This isn't a hypothetical scenario; it actually happens on a tiny strip of land called Pheasant Island. Located right on the border between France and Spain, this uninhabited island has been peacefully swapping nationalities twice a year for over three hundred and fifty years. From February to July, it belongs to Spain. Then, on August first, a quiet military handover happens, and it instantly becomes French territory. There are no passports required, no border checkpoints, and absolutely no residents allowed. It is the world’s oldest active condominium.
